title: 5.3 Food Quantities
unit_outcome: Express simple food preferences and needs and complete a supported purchase or café order.
goal: Distinguish one from more than one for countable foods and use some with familiar non-count foods.
grammar_function: one + singular; two-five + plural; some + bread/rice/water.
prerequisite: 2.6-2.8 counting and plural descriptions; 5.1-5.2 food nouns.
speaking_outcome: Say six short food-quantity chunks with intelligible number and noun endings.

cards.pedagogy_note: Plural -s introduced in a known count frame.
Tests noun within some chunk, not quantity size.
Removes count-unit readings such as one water and prevents untaught waters from first appearing as a distractor.
Purposeful review of 5.1 and number five.
Uses two already established some phrases and removes untaught breads plus context-dependent count readings.
Review number+color+noun; every distractor changes one feature.
Only Some forms the taught mass-noun phrase; avoids the valid restaurant reading one rice.
